long_description: GodHands learns how your teams actually work from the apps they already use, capturing the steps, decisions and exceptions that never get written down. It turns them into playbooks, gives people and AI agents the answers, and builds agents that do the work the same way. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard new hires, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions and automate repetitive work.

launches.title: GodHands: Agents that learn by watching your best people
launches.tagline: The know-how your team runs on was never written down. GodHands learns it from the work itself.
launches.body:
We're[ Sai Vamshi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sai-vamshi-batchu-129256194/) and[ Aditya](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aditya-bommakanti-6b035321a/), IIT engineers from high-frequency trading, building[ GodHands](https://godhands.ai).

**TL;DR:** GodHands learns how tasks really get done across apps, no integrations required, and turns it into playbooks your team and agents follow. Ops, support and sales teams can save millions in lost know-how and hours of repetitive work every week. Reach out for a demo!\
<https://youtu.be/CJBsjbX1MKY>

**❌ The problem**

At our previous company, a key person left. Nobody knew how they did their work. The team kept calling them long after they'd gone, and it took months to get back on track.

Every company has people like that. None of what they know is written down.

They know how to handle the refund that doesn't fit the policy, which customer gets a call instead of an email, and which spreadsheet is actually right.

So when they leave, teams fall back on handover docs, SOPs nobody updates, and weeks of shadowing.

Today's AI doesn't fix this. Agents know the internet, not how your best people work. AI knowledge tools ("company brains") read your docs and Slack, so they only know what someone wrote down.

**✅ The solution**

* **Never lose know-how when people leave.** GodHands learns how tasks get done across every app, including the steps, the decisions, and the exceptions. Nothing to integrate to start learning.
* **Hand over work in days, not weeks.** GodHands turns that work into playbooks with sources, kept up to date, so whoever takes over does it the same way.
* **Agents do the work.** GodHands follows those playbooks in any app, like Slack, Zendesk, Gmail, Jira, and Salesforce. Your existing agents can use them too, so your team gets hours back every week.
* **Get new hires productive faster.** They ask GodHands how things are done and get answers from how your best people actually work, with sources.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=122209&key=user_uploads/3245390/6aa30075-0890-4e4e-b43c-3c2db71719d9)

Built for ops, sales, and CX teams, logistics and retail operators, PE and M&A teams taking over a company, and any manager whose best person just handed in their notice.

**The team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=122209&key=user_uploads/3245390/2738fb55-3098-428c-96ad-e59b216115dd)

**Sai Vamshi Batchu (CEO)** was a quantitative researcher at Graviton, India's largest HFT firm. IIT Kharagpur, CS.

**Aditya Bommakanti (CTO)** built low-latency systems at Graviton, India's largest HFT firm and has published research at NeurIPS. IIT Delhi, CS.

We spent years building systems that learn from data and act on it. Now we're building one that learns from your best people.

**Our ask**

Let's talk if:
